From Killer Queen · Turn what your stand touches into a bomb.

Theme Force and Energy

  • 1: Your stand arms an unattended object it touches as part of a Stride or Strike (one bomb at a time). 1 action: detonate it for @Damage[(2+floor((@actor.level - 1)/2))d6[force]] in a @Template[burst|distance:5]{5-ft burst}, @Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}; the blast spares creatures you choose. (The damage grows by 1d6 at every odd level.)
  • 5: Surge: arm a creature your stand hits (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates). Detonating it deals the damage to that creature with no save, double damage if it critically failed. Your bursts are now 10 ft.
  • 9: Keep two bombs armed.
  • 13: Your bursts are now 15 ft, and a creature that succeeds at its @Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} save against the creature bomb is still armed with a weaker charge: half the damage when it detonates. Surge: release a seeking bomb (a minion with 20 ft Speed) that moves to the hottest creature within 60 ft and explodes.
  • 17: Detonating one bomb detonates all of them, and a creature caught in several bursts takes the damage once plus 1d6 per extra burst.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
